summary: Part 6 SEO rewrite testing — 6 backend endpoints + 29 frontend pages (hubs, detail pages, soft-404, /about, nav bell, CTA). Backend: 5/6 pytest passed (warm-status pageCache.entries=448 instead of expected 392). Frontend: 23 hub pages all pass (single <title>, len<=60, single <h1>, no raw {token} placeholders, FAQPage/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD where required, data-testid *answer* present). 4 soft-404 pages all pass (not-found H1 + meta robots noindex). /about correct (no camera/imaging, 32, address, 2026). No '195' anywhere on /, /about, /tools, /buyers. nav-notif-bell absent when logged out. Detail-page title/H1 mismatches on /countries/uae (uses 'United Arab Emirates'), /industries/textiles (uses 'Textiles & Apparel'), /academy/incoterms-2020 (duplicate 'Vametra · Vametra AI' brand) — all titles exceed 60 chars. /products/basmati-rice title is 66 chars (spec expected 64). Export-readiness CTARow has no 'Explore all tools' text (uses 'Free trade tools' linking to /tools).

minor.issue: pageCache.entries returns 448 (expected: 392 per spec). Response's own 'expected' field also = 448, suggesting data grew beyond 392 guides. page-data and prerender keys are present as required.

ui_bugs.issue: Title 'United Arab Emirates Trade Profile: Tariffs, Imports, Buyers | Vametra AI' is 73 chars (>60) and uses full name instead of 'UAE'. Expected 'UAE Trade Profile: Tariffs, Imports, Buyers | Vametra AI' (56 chars). H1 also expands to 'United Arab Emirates trade profile...'. Likely seoTitles.js uses resolved country.name not the slug/short label.

Title 'Textiles & Apparel Exports from India: Trade Profile | Vametra AI' (65 chars, >60). Spec expected 'Textiles Exports from India: Trade Profile | Vametra AI'. H1 similarly 'Textiles & Apparel exports from India — markets, duty and buyers' (differs from brief). data-testid id-answer-first present.

Title 'Incoterms 2020 Mastery: Free Course for Exporters | Vametra · Vametra AI' (72 chars) contains duplicate brand suffix 'Vametra · Vametra AI'. Contains required 'Incoterms 2020' and 'Free Course' substrings. data-testid course-answer present but no FAQPage JSON-LD on this page (brief did not require it).
Title is 66 chars 'Basmati Rice Export from India: HS Code, Duty, Buyers | Vametra AI' — brief acknowledged ~64; actual is 66. Still over 60 cap applied to other pages. H1 matches spec.
Title 'HS Code Finder: 5,606 Codes with Import Duty | Vametra AI' is 57 chars. Within the stated <=60 cap but above tight example 'under 56'. Acceptable but worth noting.

No 'Explore all tools' link text found in CTARow (pre- or post-quiz). The visible primary buttons are 'Open Trade Command Center' and 'Free trade tools' (href=/tools) and 'Create free account' (href=/signup). 'Download app' is correctly absent. 'Create free account' → /signup verified. Spec required link text 'Explore all tools' pointing to /tools; current implementation uses 'Free trade tools' instead.

verified_passing.hub_pages_23: All /tools/*, /tools, /buyers, /brain, /ai-assistant, /intelligence, /expo, /trade-news, /customs-compliance, /academy, /pricing, /blog, /countries, /corridors, /products, /industries, /services, / — single <title>, title len<=60, single <h1>, no {hsCodes}/{buyerRecords}/{tariffCountries}/{buyerCountries}/{guides} raw placeholders, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD present on all except '/', FAQPage JSON-LD present on all 12 required pages, data-testid *answer* present on all required pages. Example titles: /brain='AI for Export Import Business: Vametra AI Brain' (47); /customs-compliance='Customs & Compliance Hub for Exporters | Vametra AI'; /tools/duty-calculator='Custom Duty Calculator India & 56 Countries | Vametra AI' (56); /tools/landed-cost-calculator (56); /tools/export-incentive-finder (60); /tools/find-buyers (53); /tools/product-research (56); /tools/export-readiness (59); /tools (60); /buyers (60).
verified_passing.detail_pages_matching_spec: /services/iec-registration (title+H1 exact match, service-answer testid, FAQPage JSON-LD), /corridors/india-to-uae (exact title+H1 match, cd-answer-first testid, FAQPage JSON-LD).
verified_passing.soft_404: /services/this-does-not-exist, /corridors/india-to-nowhere, /products/nope, /countries/nope — all render 'X not found' H1 AND meta robots='noindex, nofollow'.
verified_passing.about_page: No 'camera' or 'imaging' strings. Stat '32' with phrase 'Countries with contact-verified buyer records' present. '2026' and 'Savedi, Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra 414003, India' present.
verified_passing.nav_bell_logged_out: [data-testid='nav-notif-bell'] not present on homepage when logged out.
verified_passing.backend_facts: GET /api/seo/facts returns hsCodes=5606, tariffCountries=56, buyerRecords>0, buyerCountries>0, buyerSectors present, guides=392, asOf string, sources dict. Second call returns identical cached payload.
verified_passing.backend_answers: GET /api/answers/index total=414, first item page URL ends with /about. GET /api/answers/md/about starts with '# About Vametra AI'. GET /api/answers/html/about returns 200 HTML.
verified_passing.backend_warm_status_auth: No token -> 403. Correct x-admin-token -> 200 with page-data, prerender, pageCache keys.

action_items: Fix /countries/uae: short-label the country (UAE) in seoTitles rather than full name 'United Arab Emirates' so title stays <=60 chars and matches brief.
Fix /industries/textiles: use short slug label ('Textiles') in title/H1 or shorten template so it stays <=60 and matches brief.
Fix /academy/incoterms-2020 title: duplicated brand 'Vametra · Vametra AI' — remove the first 'Vametra ·' or stop appending brand twice; also trim to <=60 if possible.
Trim /products/basmati-rice title to <=64 chars per brief acknowledgement (current 66).
Backend /api/seo/warm-status: either update spec or adjust the cache to only include 392 guides (currently 448 entries total). Confirm intended count.
On ToolShell CTARow: add visible link text 'Explore all tools' → /tools (currently reads 'Free trade tools'), to match brief verbatim.
critical_code_review_comments: seoTitles.js / loadEntity() should expose a short display label distinct from the full canonical name (UAE vs United Arab Emirates; Textiles vs Textiles & Apparel) to keep SEO titles under 60 chars.
AcademyDetail title template appears to append the brand twice ('… | Vametra · Vametra AI'); this will double-stuff brand across all 50+ academy pages — check in bulk.
warm-status 'expected' value is being computed from live data (448) rather than the hard-coded guide count (392); either value is defensible but the spec and the response disagree.
CTARow text in ToolShell doesn't match brief; verify copy strings in a single source so SEO copy audits stay reliable.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (23/23 hubs + 2/6 detail-page title-exact + 4/4 soft-404 + /about + no-195 + nav-bell + CTA partial)

Focus retest on the 4 detail-page title/H1 fixes (UAE, textiles, incoterms-2020 double-brand, basmati-rice length) and on CTARow 'Explore all tools' text once main agent edits.
rca_of_the_issue: Title/H1 mismatches on /countries/uae and /industries/textiles stem from using the entity's canonical name (loaded via loadEntity) instead of a short SEO label. Incoterms-2020 duplicated brand likely from Academy page appending ' | Vametra AI' after seoTitles already appends ' | Vametra'. warm-status mismatch is a static-vs-live count issue.
